## Requirements

From the contract's deliverables + the adopted bl33 §trust-fields text
(`docs/build/planning/round4-bl33-ws-l6-briefs.md`):

1. `FetchTrustPolicy` MUST-data record (`hh/` namespace):
   `{admission_classes[], admitted_origins[], accepted_signers: SignerRef[],
   require_ledgered_arrival: true}` — parse/validate + canonical JSON +
   version_id-pinning into `resolved_dependencies`.
2. Admission classes: `first_party` (`https:` on `admitted_origins`),
   `signed_url` (`https:` presigned-param carriers, `FetchEntry.expires`
   enforced → `location_expired`), `content_addressed` (`ipfs:`/CID-class,
   admitted unconditionally — GATE-G7 adopted `ipfs:`), cleartext `http:`
   → `Refused{fetch = transport_refused}`; `transport_pending` interim →
   typed arms (`transport_refused`/`location_expired`/`origin_not_admitted`
   + `class_not_admitted`/`policy_absent`/`transport_unsupported`).
3. `https:` GET transport over the R4.5c home — `hh_tls::ClientTls` +
   the one `hh_wire::http` codec + the `hh_env::egress` resolver/transport
   components (`LocalTlsTransport`/`SystemResolver` — the mediated wire).
4. `bundle.member.fetched{address, location_uri, fetched_at, transport,
   outcome}` ledger rows, durable before the member reads `present`
   (`commit_kernel_row_for` before `put_blob`); registered class-table row.
5. S3 re-verify on arrival (the address IS the digest — location claims
   never trusted; already the `fetch` fold's rule, kept).
6. `kernel.fetch{path | container, addresses[], trust?,
   tls_extra_roots_file?}` — `trust` is the verbatim `FetchTrustPolicy`
   document (the fetch site resolves its `resolved_dependencies` pin);
   absent + remote locations → every remote leg refuses
   `policy_absent` on the kernel-owned `purpose="fetch"` run (no wire
   machinery is built); the ledgered-arrival rows always land on that
   run — a `require_ledgered_arrival` declaration makes an append
   failure refuse the op with the bytes undeposited.
7. Hermetic tests per admission class (accept/refuse/expiry) +
   `transport_pending`-conversion + loss/claim records; live leg:
   one real HTTPS fetch of a real `locations[]` member (USD 0,
   pinned public URL) → `hh-live-evidence/1` + `SPEND.jsonl`.
8. Discharges: DF-S4.2-1 → DONE; BL-32 remote member dated; R-2.9.3 /
   R-2.10.3 dated cells; ADR-0292/0293 trigger dispositions sheet.

Design decision (owned — ADR-0375): the fetch act rides the **real**
`EgressMediator` end to end — the kernel lazily opens a
`purpose="fetch"` run (`RunKind::Fleet`, the `ensure_registry_run`
convention) carrying the kernel scope chain
(`kernel-fetch-turn`/`kernel-fetch-mc`/`kernel-fetch-tc`/derived
`Store::effect_id`) so the mediator's effect-scoped
`security.egress.decided` validates honestly; `FetchTransport::leg`
mints an attribution token bound to that effect and drives
`mediator.handle` for every admitted `https:` GET — `requested` durable
before the decision, `decided` durable before the wire, the decision by
the same `decide_egress` an agent egress takes. The declared
`FetchTrustPolicy` lowers to a `mediated`-mode `ContainmentPolicy`
(one allow rule per `admitted_origins[]` + the signed_url wildcard GET
when the class is declared; `default_unmatched=deny`;
`non_public_destinations=allow_listed`). An earlier sketch (no egress
rows, `record_run_id` param) was rejected — a fetch-audit without
`security.egress.*` IS the unmediated shape the adopted text refuses,
and a caller-supplied run confuses the audit partition.

## Plan

- `crates/hh-bundle/src/trust.rs` (new): `FetchTrustPolicy` record +
  `AdmissionClass` + `admit()` (classify → class gate → expiry) +
  `member_fetched_payload` (the one spelling of the ledger payload).
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/fetch.rs`: `fetch` gains `(trust, remote
  fetcher, now_ms)` — per-location admit→attempt→verify; per-location
  fetched records in `FetchOutcome.records`.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/fetch_transport.rs` (new): `https:` GET over the
  real `EgressMediator` (`SystemResolver` + `LocalTlsTransport` — the
  mediator's own wire, CC1) with the derived mediated-mode
  `ContainmentPolicy`.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs::kernel_fetch`: `trust` /
  `tls_extra_roots_file` params; kernel-owned `purpose="fetch"` run
  (`ensure_fetch_run` + kernel scope chain); fetched rows via
  `commit_kernel_row_for` before pool deposit.
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` + `hh-ontology/src/planes.rs` +
  `hh-ledger/src/event.rs`: register `bundle.member.fetched` and the
  `Bundle` event family (→ run_lifecycle plane).
- Tests: `hh-bundle/tests/r4_15d.rs`, `hh-embed/tests/r4_15d.rs`
  (loopback TLS fixture over `hh-tls/fixtures/pki`, `127.0.0.1` IP-SAN

- Records: ADR-0375 (mediation shape);
